responsibility: Core declaration and type-construction module for the Ada-to-GCC bridge. It builds and updates GCC decls and types for GNAT entities, manages naming and external-name encoding, computes Ada-specific size notions such as RM size, handles incomplete and dummy-profile types, caches value annotations and dummy-type/subprogram associations, and performs structural substitutions within GCC types, making it the main owner of entity/type lowering from Ada semantic objects into GCC tree declarations.
